preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner
Attacker must hold some tokens to trigger fee collection

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setAllFeePercent() to set walletFee to maximum (10%) and set feeWallet to your own address. Then perform a token transfer to trigger fee collection, which will send 10% of the transaction amount to your wallet as BNB via swapAndLiquify mechanism. This exploits the owner's ability to set fees beyond reasonable limits and redirect fee collection.
